title: Settlement Payment Amount on a Security Deposit Account Balance Owed
content:
The settlement payment on a Security Deposit Account is the balance owed standing less a settlement allowance.

## Terms

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| Balance owed standing | Every balance owed billed on the account, less every payment received against it and every credit posted against it |
| Settlement rate | 0.01 (1 percent) |
| Settlement allowance | The settlement rate applied to the balance owed standing, rounded half up to the cent, and never more than 10.00 USD |
| Settlement payment | The balance owed standing less the settlement allowance, rounded half up to the cent |

**Records read.** The balance owed lines billed on the account, the payments received against the balance owed, and the credits posted against it (dispute credits and small-balance write-off credits alike). All come from the account's own transactions.

## Worked figures (hypothetical accounts)

**Account A.** 600.00 USD billed as balance owed, one payment of 100.00 and one credit of 50.00.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Balance owed standing: 600.00 less 100.00 less 50.00 | 450.00 |
| Allowance: 0.01 times 450.00 | 4.50 (under 10.00) |
| Settlement payment: 450.00 less 4.50 | 445.50 |

**Account B.** 1500.00 USD billed, with nothing paid or credited.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Balance owed standing | 1500.00 |
| Allowance: 0.01 times 1500.00 is 15.00, held to no more than 10.00 | 10.00 |
| Settlement payment: 1500.00 less 10.00 | 1490.00 |

**Rounding point.** The allowance is rounded half up to the cent before it is held to 10.00 USD. For a standing balance of 432.55 USD, 0.01 times that is 4.3255, which rounds to 4.33. The settlement payment is then 428.22 USD.
